## What changes?

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, type checks, formatting, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Generated browser bundle and example SVG changes are included.
- [ ] UI changes were checked on desktop, at 360px, and with the keyboard.
- [ ] SVGs remain self-contained; URL compatibility and reduced motion are preserved.
- [ ] API/MCP changes pass `npm run build:api` (if applicable).

Include screenshots for visual changes and note any checks you could not run.
